rolled through 8 passes with total reduction of 72% and 15% reduction for per pass. During each pass the samples were reheated at 773 K for 20 min. The rollers were heated to 473 K with a speed of 6 rpm.
Some of rolled sheets were subjected to ageing treatment at 473 K for 30 h.
